BiblicalUsage: Of a truth, says Nebuchadnezzar, your God is a God of gods and a Lord of kings, a revealer of secrets. And at the end he praises the King of heaven, all whose works are truth. The word is the fidelity itself, the certainty.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a pagan king confessing that God's works are truth is the fruit of Daniel's witness, and the word means it.
RelatedEvents: Nebuchadnezzar's Dream of the Image; Nebuchadnezzar's Humbling
